{{Quote|I cannot leave the Empire in the hands of fools like you.|Admiral Daala, executing the Imperial Warlords|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
The '''United Warlord Fleets''', also known as the '''Deep Core Empire''', was a large [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] created late during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] around [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], and was created when Daala [[Death/Legends|executed]] the assembled [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]] and took [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of their remaining forces. Utilizing the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Knight Hammer]]'' as her [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], and using various [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], vehicles, and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], Imperial forces carried on guerrilla warfare against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Daala lost a majority of the fleet at the climactic [[Assault on Yavin 4|Assault on]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], where she planned on wiping out [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[New Jedi Order]]. Daala's failure made her hand over command of the ruined fleet to Admiral [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], who would eventually regroup with scattered Imperial factions within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
===Battle of Endor===
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] lost the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Not only did they lose the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] and the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], but [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] [[Death/Legends|perished]], along with a majority of [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial leadership]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

===Post-Endor era===
The [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] would scramble into the hands of [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]], [[Admiral/Legends|Admirals]], and [[General/Legends|Generals]] who proclaimed the title of [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]]. [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Director]] [[Ysanne Isard]] remained truly loyal to [[New Order/Legends|Palpatine's Empire]]. Isard led the Empire until the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberated]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

====Thrawn's campaign====
After the fall of Coruscant, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] [[8 ABY/Legends|returned]] [[Empire of the Hand|from]] the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. He was appointed [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander of Imperial Forces]] by the remaining Imperial Ruling Council based on [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]]. Thrawn helped form a [[Thrawn's confederation|unified]] [[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|military]], and it almost seemed as though the Empire would defeat the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Thrawn perished at the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|Battle of Bilbringi]], at the hands his of [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Noghri Death Commando|bodyguard]] [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]].

====Operation Shadow Hand====
[[File:EmperorReborn-PTP2.jpg|thumb|253x253px|The Reborn Emperor, and his new military force]]
Although the New Republic expected there to be relative peace, Thrawn's death had shown [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] that the New Republic could be defeated. [[Second Battle of Coruscant|Striking]] [[Deep Core/Legends|at the]] New Republic, Imperial forces [[Pre–Shadow Hand campaign|divided]] and conquered. It was later revealed that Imperial forces were being coordinated by the reborn Emperor Palpatine, who was based on [[Byss/Legends|Byss]]. Palpatine unleashed new powerful [[Superweapon/Legends|weapons]], from the [[World Devastator]]s, [[Eclipse-class dreadnought|''Eclipse''-class dreadnoughts]], [[Sovereign-class Super Star Destroyer|''Sovereign''-class]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], and the [[Galaxy Gun]]. Palpatine was defeated [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|above]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], and the ''[[Eclipse II]]'' [[Destruction of Byss|set course]] and rammed the Galaxy Gun stationed above Byss. Byss was destroyed, and the [[Dark Empire]] was vanquished.

====Discovery of the Maw Installation====
In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were sent to negotiate terms at [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. They were shot down by the [[Doole's defense fleet|defense force]] stationed at Kessel. It was later revealed that Kessel was overrun by [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. They had come together to serve [[Moruth Doole]], [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] of the planet's spice mines. Solo and Chewie escaped, with help from young [[Kyp Durron]]. They fled the planet, and into [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]. Unknown to them, the Maw housed a top-secret [[Maw Installation|Imperial research facility]]. Solo was captured by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]], [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Maw fleet|forces]] and the base. Daala was [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] protégé, and when Daala found out of [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|his death at]] [[Yavin 4]], she decided to [[Daala campaign|avenge]] Tarkin and the [[Imperial Civil War|fallen Empire]]. Her campaign was short lived, with the [[Sun Crusher]] being stolen by Kyp Durron, and later, Daala lost more and more of her fleet. She eventually [[Battle of the Maw|lost]] her secret installation at the hands of the New Republic.

===Imperial Reunification===
{{Quote|I didn't ''want'' to rule. I had no ''intention'' of becoming a political leader&mdash;but you have given me no choice. I cannot leave the Empire in the hands of fools like you.|Natasi Daala to other Galactic Imperial warlords at Tsoss Beacon|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
[[File:Harder_to_Breathe_TERC.jpg|left|thumb|231x231px|Daala executes all thirteen Imperial warlords.]]
After the [[Battle of the Maw|major loss]] of the Maw Installation, Daala wandered across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], inspecting splinter factions. Daala eventually met and talked with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Blitzer Harrsk]], a major warlord. Little did both know, Admiral [[Treuten Teradoc]], a rival warlord, would [[Battle of Harrsk's fortress|attack Harrsk's fortress]] by using [[Crimson Command]], led by [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] comprising 73 of [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]]. Harrsk, greatly angered by the attack and the loss of his flagship [[Shockwave (Imperial-class)|''Shockwave'']], [[Battle of Teradoc's fortress|retaliated by attacking]] Teradoc back. He forced Daala to take command of the [[Firestorm (Imperial-class)|''Firestorm'']], and if she didn't, he would have his troops execute her for [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. Daala complied, with not much say in the matter. They arrived, finding Teradoc's fortress based within an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|field]]. They briefly encountered [[Space mine/Legends|space mines]] planted by Teradoc, but resumed the attack. Teradoc watched the battle from his command bunker, and the fight ended when Daala disabled the [[Whirlwind (Imperial-class)|''Whirlwind'']], Harrsk's ship. She threatened them by blowing up the ''Firestorm'' if they didn't listen. The fight ended, and Daala [[Imperial Reunification|called out]] thirteen of the most powerful warlords at [[Tsoss Beacon/Legends|Tsoss Beacon]], an Imperial listening post. They met there to discuss the future of the Empire, and Daala planned on reuniting the various factions. Little did this help, as the Imperial warlords fought for hours, as they all held rivalry with each other. Daala, having heard enough, and realizing they wouldn't agree on anything, prepared her second plan by releasing a [[Nerve toxin/Legends|nerve gas]] which filled the room, and wore a gas mask alongside Pellaeon. The two watched as the warlords died, and Daala resumed command of their remaining forces for a final fight against the New Republic. The deaths of all thirteen Imperial warlords ended the [[Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>

====Beginning conquest====
Daala first headed to [[Kampe]], which [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sander Delvardus]] used as [[Delvardus's fortress|his base of operations]]. Daala presented Delvardus's corpse on a frame to his second in command, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ivan Cronus]]. Daala gave Cronus a choice, join or die. Cronus decided to join Daala's new faction, and presented her a gift, the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Knight Hammer|''Night Hammer'']], which Delvardus planned on using. Daala took the ''Night Hammer'' as her [[Flagship/Legends|personal flagship]], renaming it ''Knight Hammer''. Daala gave a large bulk of Crimson Command to Cronus, and Cronus [[Attack on Khomm|attacked]] [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]]. He later [[Battle of the Chardaan Shipyards|struck at]] [[Chardaan Shipyards]], and [[Attack on Porus Vida|later at]] [[Porus Vida]], scoring major victories.<ref name="Darksaber" />

====Major failure====
{{Quote|You will take your fleet of Imperial Star Destroyers directly to Yavin 4 and proceed with its complete destruction. I will follow in the ''Night Hammer'' with sufficient force to occupy the Rebel base permanently.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]]|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
Within these major victories, Daala and Pellaeon both agreed that it was time to wipe out [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[New Jedi Order]]. As such, seventeen [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] were [[Assault on Yavin 4|dispatched to]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], led by Pellaeon. Pellaeon and his fleet arrived above the planet and launched a large ground force to attack the Jedi. The Jedi were overrun and retreated to the temple, where they all used their [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers to generate a shockwave which flung Pellaeon's fleet out of Yavin 4's orbit and beyond the fringes of the system. With Pellaeon taken care of, Daala would arrive with her fleet alongside Cronus's fleet. But New Republic reinforcements under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] came into the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and attacked Daala. Daala was surprised when [[Callista Ming]] hijacked a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]] and flew it into the ''Knight Hammer'', effectively destroying it.<ref name="Darksaber" />

====Aftermath====
With the destruction of the ''Knight Hammer'', and a large bulk of the military force, Daala relinquished her command of the fleet to Pellaeon, which made him the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]]. Pellaeon took his seventeen Star Destroyers and regrouped with surviving Imperial forces throughout the galaxy.<ref name="Darksaber" />

==Headquarters==
===Deep Core===
[[File:DeepCore-TEA.png|thumb|196x196px|The Deep Core]]
Although not utilizing a traditional [[Coruscant/Legends|planetary capital]] like the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the primary headquarters of the fleet was the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. The entire Deep Core was seeded by [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], [[Factory/Legends|factories]], and various military installations to which Daala had within her power.<ref name="Darksaber" />

===''Knight Hammer''===
The [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] ''[[Knight Hammer]]'', personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of Daala, served as a mobile [[Command ship/Legends|command]] base of the faction. Daala was able to command her military forces aboard the ship and across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Darksaber" />

==Military==
{{Quote|I have seen what remains of the Imperial starfleet. I've visited most of you in the past year, urging you to put aside your differences. Supreme Warlord Harrsk has a fleet of Imperial Star Destroyers. High Admiral Teradoc has a force of ''Victory''-class warships. You others have blastboats, capital ships, millions upon millions of stormtroopers&mdash;unstoppable military might if we choose to use it as such! Grand Admiral Thrawn proved the Rebels have not yet managed to consolidate their own meager resources. Because of your rivalries, every one of your sectors has devoted vast resources to creating weaponry. It is time to use those resources against our real enemies instead of against each other.''"<br />"''Fine words, Admiral Daala. And how do you propose that we do that?''"<br />"''By forging an alliance. If the Rebels can do it, so can we.|Natasi Daala and Blitzer Harrsk at Tsoss Beacon|<ref name="Darksaber" />}}
[[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyers]], and one modified [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] provided the United Fleet with [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|unlimited firepower]].<ref name="Darksaber" />

[[Mine/Legends|Proximity Mines]] were used by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ivan Cronus]] during the [[Battle of the Chardaan Shipyards|attack on]] [[Chardaan Shipyards]].<ref name="Darksaber" />
[[File:JediVersusJuggernaught-NEC.jpg|thumb|left|261x261px|Ground forces attack Jedi]]
[[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]], [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]], and [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat]]s were used as primary [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]] was also used by the fleet.<ref name="Darksaber" />

[[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtroopers]] served as the main attack force, and security of the fleet. A detachment of [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Royal Guards]] was also in service to Daala.<ref name="Darksaber" />

[[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]], [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut]]s, [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|HAVr A9 Floating Fortresses]] were the ground forces of the fleet. [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class Landing Craft]], served as the primary [[Transport/Legends|transport]] of the fleet.<ref name="Darksaber" />

[[Second Imperium]], another splinter faction led by Daala, was also part of its military forces.<ref name="Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|There are a few other continuity details scattered through this one: the name of United Warlord Fleets for her command in ''Darksaber'' is new, and alert fans might also note that this biography makes her the military leader of the Second Imperium in the ''Young Jedi Knights'' novels. The fake Royal Guards who purport to be leading the show were originally ''her'' bodyguards, after all&hellip;|Paul Urquhart, speaking about Admiral Daala in the endnotes for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''|<ref name="Warfare endnotes 16" />}}
The United Warlord Fleets were first mentioned by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] in the [[2012]] guidebook ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', and in the endnotes to the book, Urquhart confirmed that the command was intended to be the faction that Admiral Daala seized control of in [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']],<ref name="Warfare endnotes 16">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/27417920547/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-16|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 16}}</ref> a [[1995]] novel by [[Kevin J. Anderson]].
